$comment: Copy to project root as stress-test-config.json and customize.
_projectNameNote: Replace before Phase 1 — template default is CONFIG_INVALID.
_figmaFileKeyNote: Replace with real file key or parse from Figma URL before Phase 1 when using Figma MCP.
_baselineNodeIdNote: Replace with real node ID (e.g. 1234:5678) before Phase 1 when using Figma MCP.
_customLocalesNote: Ignored when localePack is core or extended. When localePack is custom, replace [] with at least one BCP-47 code before Phase 1.
_reportOnlyNote: When true with executionPath prototype: Cursor-report-only — no Figma matrix, upload_assets, or Phase 4.
